Article Title: ‘Let's get to work’: Microsoft AI CEO Mustafa Suleyman after Satya Nadella backs ‘emergency brake’ for AI models
Article Text:
Microsoft AI Chief Mustafa Suleyman

Satya Nadella’s ‘emergency brake’ plan

Designing for observability over blind trust

Microsoft AI CEO Mustafa Suleyman has thrown his weight behind company chief executive Satya Nadella ’s call for mandatory safeguards on advanced artificial intelligence (AI), declaring that containing superintelligence is an achievable technical hurdle the tech industry must tackle immediately. Reacting to Nadella’s safety proposals, Suleyman emphasised that humanity has successfully tamed high-risk innovations throughout history, framing AI oversight as a standard engineering milestone rather than an unsolvable dilemma.“Super Intelligence must be contained... Today, this is an engineering and governance challenge. And it isn't new. We've done it with planes, cars, nuclear materials, food safety, medicines... and everything else. Let's get to work!” Suleyman wrote in a post on X (formerly Twitter).Suleyman’s remarks follow an extensive position statement published on X by Nadella on Saturday, where the Microsoft chief urged developers to equip advanced AI systems with hard boundaries, external oversight, and a literal “emergency brake” allowing authorised operators to halt or disconnect a system in the middle of an operation.Nadella argued that unpredictable generative algorithms cannot be left unchecked and must be insulated by rigid, deterministic software guardrails.“We need to surround non-deterministic models with strong, deterministic system design, human controls, and reliable operating procedures, and establish industry standards where existing ones are insufficient,” Nadella wrote.He went further by suggesting that frontier systems, whether closed-source proprietary platforms or open-weight releases, should be approached with the same defensive mindset companies apply to internal security vulnerabilities: “Treating frontier closed and open weight models like insider risks is a way to build such a system.”Outlining a technical blueprint for the superintelligence era, Nadella argued that safety frameworks should be built on core “principles of observability” rather than blind reliance on a model’s good behaviour. His proposed framework hinges on six primary operational requirements, including model diversity, human-readable footprints, continuous system testing, independent controls and auditability, containment and mandatory incident disclosure.
Article Summary: Microsoft AI CEO Mustafa Suleyman has thrown his weight behind Satya Nadella’s call for mandatory safeguards on advanced artificial intelligence (AI) He said that containing superintelligence is an achievable technical hurdle the tech industry must tackle immediately. Suley man emphasised that humanity has successfully tamed high-risk innovations throughout history.

Article Title: Swiss watches that Google's top execs are reportedly 'obsessed with,' and made Tudor build a special edition for them
Article Text:
Google employees got Tudor to build them their own Swiss watch

Tudor needs at least 40 buyers before it customises a watch

OpenAI, Palantir and Uber staff have their own limited-edition Tudors

Custom tech-company Tudor watches are selling for double their retail price

Silicon Valley has a new way to flex, and at Google , it comes with a Swiss movement and a Tudor logo. In August, a post showing custom Tudor watches built for Googlers started circulating on X, and staffers at OpenAI, Palantir, Uber and Perplexity were soon replying with photos of their own company-branded timepieces. The Google edition is based on the Tudor Pelagos, a titanium diver that retails for around $4,500 (roughly Rs 4.3 lakh). Google does not hand these out. Like most of these watches, it was ordered by an internal group of watch collectors, paid for out of pocket, and is usually available only to members of the group that commissioned it.Tudor, Rolex’s sister brand, runs a customisation programme with a minimum order of 40 watches, according to the managing editor of a luxury watch news site. Production takes about six months. Employee collector groups do the work of rounding up enough interested buyers, and each member pays full retail price.That setup keeps runs small and designs private. A watch made for one company’s collector group tends to stay within that group, so every edition is rare by default.OpenAI’s head of applied research, Boris Power, posted the company’s version, which has “Good Research Takes Time” engraved on the caseback.The same slogan appears on T-shirts OpenAI sells, and Power has said Tudor made 400 of these with OpenAI’s logo on the dial.Palantir’s strategic engagement head, Eliano Younes, said the company’s run was limited to 468 pieces, with a barely noticeable Palantir logo on the dial. Uber engineer Alex Feng shared a caseback marked 1/100, the first watch in a batch of 100. A former Facebook employee admitted he regretted not buying every custom model made during his six years there.Tudor is not the only maker involved. Adobe’s watch club is working with British brand Studio Underd0g on 128 branded pieces at about $1,200 (around Rs 1.2 lakh) each. OpenAI CEO Sam Altman went further, commissioning just seven watches from Swiss maker Vanguart, based on a model that starts at $180,000 (about Rs 1.7 crore), with “COMPUTE IS DESTINY” engraved around the rotor.Rarity carries a premium. A Google-themed Tudor featuring Chrome’s offline dinosaur sold for over $10,000 (about Rs 9.6 lakh) at auction earlier this year, while an Apple “pirate” edition drew a $13,500 (around Rs 13 lakh) bid. A Meta-branded Tudor Black Bay 54 has attracted bids as high as $10,500 (about Rs 10 lakh), against a standard price of $4,725 (roughly Rs 4.6 lakh).Not every branded watch fetches those numbers, and one online watch auctioneer pointed out that some buyers simply find them ugly. For the people ordering them, the draw is belonging. An Adobe designer who owns about 40 watches described these pieces as a ticket into an insider club.Google’s own chief is the odd one out. Sundar Pichai’s most talked-about watch moment came in 2022, when he wore an unreleased Pixel Watch on stage. His employees, it seems, would rather wear the company logo on a Swiss movement.
Article Summary: Tudor, Rolex’s sister brand, runs a customisation programme with a minimum order of 40 watches. Employee collector groups do the work of rounding up enough interested buyers, and each member pays full retail price. A Google-themed Tudor featuring Chrome's offline dinosaur sold for over $10,000 at auction earlier this year.

Article Title: Dallas Cowboys cheerleaders reveal the small details that make a difference during demanding game days
Article Text:
Dallas Cowboys cheerleaders rely on primer , powder and setting spray

Dallas Cowboys cheerleaders use layered makeup for lasting results

Join conversation View All Comments → Share your thoughts in the comments Post Comment Be respectful · TOI community guidelines

Keeping makeup fresh through hours of heat, bright lights and energetic performances is no easy task. Yet the Dallas Cowboys Cheerleaders have mastered the art of maintaining a polished look long after the first application. Their game-day beauty routines offer useful lessons for anyone who struggles with melting foundation, fading blush or unwanted shine. From carefully layering products to using setting spray generously, these cheerleaders rely on practical techniques that help their makeup last. The best part? You do not need to perform on an NFL field to put these beauty secrets to work.A long-lasting makeup routine starts well before the lipstick goes on. According to beauty tips shared by Dallas Cowboys Cheerleaders in their social media tutorials, preparing the skin and securing each layer are key to keeping makeup in place.Primer creates a smoother base for foundation, while setting powder helps reduce excess shine and keeps products from shifting. Setting spray adds another layer of support, making it an important step for anyone who wants makeup to withstand warm weather and a busy day.ONE/SIZE Beauty's primer and setting spray feature among the products repeatedly seen in the cheerleaders' routines. Loose powders also play a major role, particularly around the under-eyes, where makeup can crease or fade. Pink-toned powders from brands such as Rare Beauty and Givenchy are among the options featured in these looks.Application matters just as much as product choice. Rather than relying on one layer of makeup to do all the work, the cheerleaders build their base with care. For everyday wear, however, it is worth adjusting the amount of powder and spray to suit your skin type and comfort level.One of the most useful lessons from the cheerleaders' routines is the combination of cream and powder products. They often apply cream-based foundation, contour and liquid blush first, then follow with powder products to help set the colour and add staying power.For example, liquid blush can be topped with powder blush, while a contour stick can be paired with bronzer. Powder may also be applied after cream products and used again to finish the look.This layered method helps create a more durable finish than relying on a single product. Still, applying too much can make makeup look heavy, so blending each layer well is essential.The cheerleaders also keep their touch-up routine simple. Setting powder, blush, bronzer and lipstick are four useful products to carry for quick refreshes. Instead of rebuilding the entire face, you can focus on areas where makeup has faded.For best results, gently remove excess sweat before touching up, then apply only what is needed. With the right preparation, thoughtful layering and a few essentials in your bag, a fresh makeup look can last longer without constant reapplication.
Article Summary: The Dallas Cowboys Cheerleaders share their beauty tips on social media. Their game-day beauty routines offer useful lessons for anyone who struggles with melting foundation, fading blush or unwanted shine. Primer creates a smoother base for foundation, while setting powder helps reduce excess shine and keeps products from shifting.

Article Title: Minecraft 26.4 Snapshot 4 patch notes: Ice Caves Biome, Frostbite Mob, and more
Article Text:
Minecraft 26.4 Snapshot 3 is out with new features from the upcoming game drop (Image via Mojang)

Minecraft 26.4 Snapshot 4 patch notes

New Features

Added the new Ice Caves Biome

Added Ice Crystals

Added Icicles

Added the Frostbite mob

Added the Freezing mob effect

Added the Ice Ball

Ice Caves

The Ice Cave is a new cave biome that generates beneath colder Overworld biomes.

It's built mainly from Packed Ice and Calcite, with Icicles hanging from the ceiling and Large Icicles made of Packed Ice forming both on the ground and overhead.

Patches of Snow occasionally appear on the floor, and ores generate embedded within pockets of Stone and Deepslate.

Alongside typical cave mobs, Strays and Frostbites can also spawn in this biome, and Ice Crystals occasionally generate on the ground.

Ice Crystal is a new crystal-like block similar to Amethyst Clusters. It breaks if its support block is removed, emits light, and can be placed in any direction.

Icicle is a new block in the same family as Dripstone and Sulfur Spikes. Icicles can naturally grow up to 5 blocks long when pointing downward, but only in areas without nearby light sources and never in the Nether.

Frostbite

The Frostbite is a new zombie variant capable of throwing Ice Balls.

It spawns in cold and icy biomes and switches between melee and ranged combat depending on target distance and whether it's currently holding Ice Balls.

Melee attacks apply the Freezing effect, while ranged attacks throw Ice Balls directly.

Frostbites transform into regular Zombies if left underwater long enough, and they drop Rotten Flesh and Ice Balls on death.

They can stand on top of Powder Snow and are immune to freezing, so neither the Freezing effect nor Powder Snow slows them down.

Interestingly, regular Zombies and Husks will transform into Frostbites if they stand inside Powder Snow.

Freezing Mob Effect

The Freezing effect causes affected players to shake and eventually take damage, gradually freezing them as though standing in Powder Snow for the duration.

Leather Armor offers protection from freezing, the same way it does against Powder Snow, though it won't prevent the effect from being applied or remove it once active.

Mobs vulnerable to Freezing take a 5x damage multiplier while affected.

Lingering Potions, Splash Potions, and a new Potion of Freezing can all be brewed using Ice Balls, and Arrows of Freezing can be crafted by placing a Lingering Potion of Freezing in the center of a crafting table surrounded by eight Arrows.

Ice Ball

Ice Balls are the new projectile thrown by Frostbites. They deal a small amount of damage along with knockback, dealing up to 4 damage on impact, scaling down based on velocity. They break apart on contact with blocks or entities, triggering a particle effect and sound.

Changes

Minor tweaks to Blocks, Items and Entities

Snow can now be placed on Packed Ice

Snowballs now apply knockback to players

UI

Lightmap visualization is now configurable as lightmap_texture in debug options and appears in the Light group; its visibility is saved with the debug profile and can now be displayed alongside the FPS and network charts

The Social Interactions screen has been replaced with the new Other Players screen

The "Social Interactions" keybind has been renamed to "Other Players"

The Friends button has received a new icon

The "Visibility" option has moved from Online Options into the Friends list

Icon buttons in the pause menu have been reordered to match the main menu

Friends

Updated the design of the Friends list

Added searching - the profile name text box in the Friends tab now doubles as a search box, and a search box appears in the requests tab once you have 15 or more pending requests

Added sorting - a new sort button cycles between sorting by who's online and alphabetical order

Clicking a player's icon in the Friends list now opens their Player Options

Removed the "Remove Friend" button; this is now handled through Player Options instead

Player Reporting

Redesigned the save/discard draft confirmation screen

Saved report drafts no longer prompt you to discard them when exiting a world, if they can be continued later

Chat reports can never be continued; Name and Skin reports can be continued if the reported player is still in your Friends list

Pressing "Quit Game" in the main menu now warns you if an unsent draft report would be lost

Debug Overlay

Added chunk_section_status, showing the rendering status of chunks around you (impacts performance at high view distances)

Split the chunk load overlay off from visualize_chunks_on_server into a new chunk_load_status

Technical Changes

Data Pack version is now 123.0

Resource Pack version is now 100.0

Numerous world generation changes, including a reworked minecraft:speleothem_cluster feature with new placement options, a renamed minecraft:large_dripstone feature, new Ice Cave ore placements, a new minecraft:block_sound_set registry, several new block/item/biome tags for pathfinding and ore replacement, and a new minecraft:freezing particle type

Numerous new block, item, UI, and entity textures and sounds added to support Ice Caves, Icicles, Ice Crystals, the Frostbite, and the Freezing effect

Several UI textures renamed or removed as part of the Friends and Other Players redesign

Fixed Bugs in 26.4 Snapshot 3

MC-212616 - The dye staining sound does not play when dyes are used on tamed wolves or cats

MC-303468 - Pets can be teleported to incorrect coordinates when going through a nether portal

MC-306017 - The main arm doesn't swing when making a tamed wolf sit or stand while holding a matching dye

MC-307830 - Framerate limited to 20 fps with the Vulkan rendering backend on some systems

MC-308037 - Unselected tabs in the friends menu show white text instead of gray

MC-308051 - Icons on several buttons don't adhere to the UI pixel grid

MC-308747 - The social interactions button is grayed out in LAN worlds with no players

MC-308994 - The Chat Restrictions screen doesn't display Xbox communication settings affecting chat

MC-309896 - Missing periods on two tooltip strings

MC-309906 - Inconsistent capitalization of "Friends List" across strings

MC-310124 - Leaving a keyboard-opened menu doesn't reselect its button on the previous screen

MC-310237 - A friends error string uses an em dash inconsistently

MC-310854 - Inconsistent button outlines in the friends screen

MC-311932 - Caps Lock could no longer trigger sprint/sneak toggles set to "Hold"

MC-311963 - A Poplar leaves subtitle string used incorrect grammar

MC-312120 - Exclusive Fullscreen toggle button doesn't update properly in windowed mode

MC-312198 - Almost no small mushrooms generate on mushroom islands

MC-312213 - Game crashes with custom Superflat presets containing air

Mojang has released Minecraft 26.4 Snapshot 4, giving players their first hands-on look at the frosty new game drop teased at Minecraft Live. The headline addition is the Ice Caves Biome, a new underground environment filled with icicles and glowing Ice Crystals, alongside the Frostbite - a chilling new zombie variant that can freeze players with its attacks.Beyond the frozen content, this snapshot also brings a significant overhaul to the Friends system, introducing a refreshed list design, new search and sorting tools, and a redesigned Other Players menu. In the section below, we take a detailed look at everything new in Minecraft 26.4 Snapshot 4.Snapshots are available for Minecraft: Java Edition. To install, open the Minecraft Launcher and enable snapshots in the "Installations" tab.This was all you needed to know about Minecraft 26.4 Snapshot 3 patch notes.
Article Summary: Minecraft 26.4 Snapshot 3 is out with new features from the upcoming game drop. Ice Caves is a new cave biome that generates beneath colder Overworld biomes. Frostbites are a new zombie variant capable of throwing Ice Balls. Snowballs now apply knockback to players.

Article Title: Jaguar unveils Type 01 electric car with 1,030PS power and 450-mile range
Article Text:
Jaguar Type 01

Jaguar Type 01 revealed: 0-62mph in 3.2 seconds, 450-mile range and luxury cabin

A modern cabin with new technology

What does the Type 01 name mean?

Join conversation View All Comments → Share your thoughts in the comments Post Comment Be respectful · TOI community guidelines

When will the Jaguar Type 01 go on sale?

Jaguar on Friday unveiled the Type 01, an all-electric luxury car that marks a new beginning for the British carmaker. Revealed in New York City, the four-door grand tourer combines high performance with modern design and new technology. One of the car's biggest highlights is its acceleration. It can go from 0 to 62 mph in just 3.2 seconds. It has three electric motors that produce 1,030PS of power and 1,365Nm of torque.The Type 01 is Jaguar's new flagship electric car. It comes with a 118kWh usable battery pack and offers a claimed range of up to 400 miles under US EPA testing. Its range is up to 450 miles (720km) under WLTP testing.The car uses an 850-volt electrical system that supports fast charging. When connected to a 350kW DC fast charger, it can add 200 miles of range in just 13 minutes.ID@undefined Caption not available.Built on Jaguar's new Electric Architecture (JEA), the Type 01 has been designed to offer a balance of performance and comfort. Its design includes a low roof, a long bonnet, a short front overhang and large 23-inch wheels. The car also has a 50:50 weight distribution, which is aimed at improving handling.Jaguar has also added intelligent torque vectoring and active aerodynamics to improve performance. These features include movable air vents and a rear spoiler that can extend in three stages. The car has a drag coefficient of 0.23, helping it move through the air more efficiently.The Type 01 has a cabin designed around luxury and technology. A central section divides the interior into four separate areas.The cabin features brass-effect aluminium trim, a 24-inch OLED driver display made from a single piece of glass and a separate 7-inch touchscreen. It also gets a full-width panoramic soundbar and seats with audio features designed to improve the listening experience.Jaguar says the name Type 01 reflects both its history and its future. The word "Type" pays tribute to famous models from the brand's past. The number "0" represents zero emissions, while "1" marks the first car of its new generation.The car also benefits from technology developed through Jaguar TCS Racing's Formula E programme, which has won two world championships.The Type 01 can accelerate from 62 mph to 112 mph (100km/h to 180km/h) in just 4.0 seconds.Designed, engineered and manufactured in the UK, the Type 01 is an important part of Jaguar's move towards becoming a fully electric luxury car brand. Prices start at £130,000, with the US price listed at $130,500. Higher-specification versions and customised models are expected to cost more than £150,000.Jaguar plans to open order books in early 2027, with the first customer deliveries expected in the second half of the year.Also read: Sebastien Buemi ends full-time Formula E career, stays with Envision as advisor
Article Summary: The Type 01 is Jaguar's new flagship electric car. It has three electric motors that produce 1,030PS of power and 1,365Nm of torque. It can go from 0 to 62 mph in just 3.2 seconds. Prices start at £130,000, with the US price listed at $130,500.

Article Title: Formula E names COMSOL its Official Multiphysics Partner in new multi-year deal
Article Text:
Formula E and Comsol

Formula E joins hands with COMSOL to boost electric racing technology

AI and digital twins also in focus

Join conversation View All Comments → Share your thoughts in the comments Post Comment Be respectful · TOI community guidelines

GEN4 to bring bigger technology demands

Formula E on Thursday announced a new multi-year partnership with COMSOL, which will become the Official Multiphysics Partner of the ABB FIA Formula E World Championship. The partnership brings together Formula E, the world's leading all-electric motorsport championship, and COMSOL, a company known for its multiphysics simulation and computer-aided engineering software. As part of the partnership, Formula E and COMSOL engineers will use COMSOL Multiphysics to study complex engineering problems involving several physical systems working together.Electric race cars depend on several systems at the same time. These include electrical, thermal, structural, electromagnetic, fluid and battery systems.All these systems have to work together under tough performance and energy limits. COMSOL will provide Formula E's technology teams with simulation software and technical expertise to help them understand how these different physical effects interact.ID@undefined Caption not available.The partnership will also look at simulation apps and digital twin technology. The aim is to make engineering information easier to use outside the traditional modelling process.Bjorn Sjodin, SVP of Product Management at COMSOL, said, “Formula E is a great example of why multiphysics simulation matters, as multiple phenomena are at play and constantly interact with one another.We are excited to work directly with Formula E's technology team and put COMSOL Multiphysics to work on these kinds of real-world challenges.”Formula E CTO Dan Cherowbrier said the partnership will strengthen the championship's engineering capabilities.“Technology is at the heart of Formula E, so partnering with COMSOL makes real sense for us and truly enhances our engineering skillsets. COMSOL gives us a powerful environment for understanding complex systems where many different physical effects are connected, but the opportunity goes beyond individual simulations. We're particularly interested in how AI-assisted modelling, agentic workflows, and digital twins can help engineers interact with models, explore designs, and make simulation insight more accessible as we continue to push the limits of electric racing,” he said.The partnership comes as Formula E prepares for the next generation of its cars.The GEN4 era will bring greater demands in areas such as speed, efficiency, energy management and vehicle development. It will introduce what Formula E describes as its fastest and most technologically advanced race car so far.COMSOL has also announced COMSOL Multiphysics version 2027, which is scheduled to arrive later this autumn.The new version will include features aimed at advanced engineering work, including dedicated electric motor modelling, system-level simulation, agentic modelling and wider access to tools for creating simulation apps.The partnership was announced at the COMSOL Conference 2026 Boston. Formula E CTO Dan Cherowbrier also delivered a keynote speech at the event, discussing the technology and engineering that could shape the future of Formula E.
Article Summary: Formula E joins hands with COMSOL to boost electric racing technology. Aim is to make engineering information easier to use outside the traditional modelling process. AI and digital twins also in focus as Formula E prepares for the next generation of its cars.
